frontmatter.title: Reload a workorder from server from Workorder detail page

internal.content:
---
title: Reload a workorder from server from Workorder detail page
---

## About this task

This guide explains how to add a reload button on workorder detail page to reload the workorder from server having latest data

## Procedure

### Step 1: In app.xml, Add a button before the work order Edit button

```xml
  <button icon="carbon:renew" kind="ghost" padding="false" on-click="reloadWO" disabled="{!app.state.networkConnected}"/>
```

### Step 2: In appCustomizations.js - add a new function as

```js
  async reloadWO() { 
    await this.app.findDatasource('woDetailResource').forceSync();
  }
```

### Step 3: (Optional):  Alter the adaptive-column's width in app.xml to adjust spacing for the new button on medium and large screens.

* For the button's container adaptive-column change
`xlarge-width="5" large-width="10"` to `xlarge-width="15" large-width="20"`
* and for its previous adaptive-column change 
`xlarge-width="35" large-width="90"` to `xlarge-width="25" large-width="80"`
